title: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c:465 Race condition: lichen_announce_reset() acquires only announce_mutex, not ingest_mutex. If called while lichen_announce_ingest_authenticated() is between releasing announce_mutex (line 364) and re-acquiring it (line 377), reset clears the peer table while ingest still holds a pointer to a peer slot. The subsequent write to peer->seq_num (line 378) corrupts a cleared slot, leaving ghost state with active=false but non-zero seq_num.
